nodes.name: Workout operation semantics and precise targets
nodes.recommendation: Shared typed operation envelope plus domain-specific patch functions; retain unaffected identities, count and content.

nodes.name: Constraint capture and lifecycle across turns
nodes.recommendation: Workflow-scoped symptom/restriction state with provenance, uncertainty, status and explicit resolution; nutrition union semantics are insufficient for safety.

nodes.name: Unequal validation across generation surfaces
nodes.recommendation: Normalize proposals and validate requested count and constraints after all generation paths, before display and persistence.

nodes.name: Explicit versus default duration not carried to chat request
nodes.recommendation: Preserve user-specified, unspecified and open-ended intent; domain phase bounds remain valid.

nodes.name: Bundle lacks durable per-step recovery identity
nodes.recommendation: Persist step result IDs/status and stable per-step idempotency tokens; test crash boundaries and concurrent retry.

nodes.name: Read-modify-write without expected content revision
nodes.recommendation: Extend existing conditional transition pattern to revisions; explicit preview version at confirmation.

nodes.name: Governance scope ambiguity
nodes.recommendation: Clarify local flags; add global policy only against an agreed model-entry-point contract.

nodes.name: Partial model-entry-point authorization and budget coverage
nodes.recommendation: Use endpoint policy inventory; service-only gates or authenticated distributed user quotas on every billable path.
